Post-hoc clustering links likely siblings; flagged clusters lose API access and queued work until cleared. The rule: a new identity may harbor no more than one active account per signature cluster. An attacker pays by diversifying cheaply to terrace each account’s behavior apart, raising per-identity setup and compute cost.
